saw_lines: Travelers choosing a stopover compare it against flying straight through, and they book when the trip feels easy to add.
So the stopover sale is won in the first line, where travelers decide if the trip is worth a second look.

points: No proof number in your ads
None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has no reason to trust the trip before clicking. Collect one real figure, like a review count, and open the next three creatives with it.

16 of your 30 live ads are catalog feed ads with no story behind them, so a cold viewer scrolls past without knowing why Iceland matters to them. Add three story ads that give the feed a reason to stop.
0 of your 14 copy ads mention an offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to book today. Give new buyers one reason to book, a first order offer, and open three new ads with it.

Your 14 copy ads open with 9 different stories, so no single one sticks, and the biggest, daily flights from Toronto, leads just 2 ads. Pick the two strongest stories and build the next batch from them.
